User story: As a customer, I want to browse grocery categories, so that I can find products by type.
As a customer, I want to search for grocery products, so that I can quickly find the items I need.
As a customer, I want to view product details, so that I can make an informed purchase decision.
As a customer, I want to check product availability, so that I know whether an item can be ordered before adding it to my cart.
As a customer, I want to add grocery products to my shopping cart, so that I can purchase multiple items together.
As a customer, I want to increase or decrease product quantities in my cart, so that I can adjust my order.
As a customer, I want to view the total price of my cart, so that I know the amount payable before checkout.
As a customer, I want to enter my delivery details and review my order, so that I can confirm the purchase.
As a customer, I want to place my grocery order, so that the supermarket can process and deliver it.
As a customer, I want to pay securely for my grocery order, so that my payment information and transaction are protected.
As a customer, I want to view my previous orders, so that I can review past purchases.
As a customer, I want to track my order delivery status, so that I know the progress of my order.
